results.title: NBA champion player and historic coach Nelson dead at 86
results.description: SAN FRANCISCO: Don Nelson, who won the second-most games of any coach in NBA history and five NBA titles as a player with the Boston Celtics, died on Sunday, his family announced. He was 86.
